sentences.en: A long train of camels was moving to the west.
sentences.zh: 一列长长的骆驼队正向西行进。

sentences.en: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布认为可以通过向西航行到达印度。

sentences.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布向更远的西方航行以寻找新的大陆。

senses.zh: 西方，西部；西方国家，西方文明
